# Zhiwei's Technical Blog

> > A software engineer's technical blog covering Java backend development, AI coding tools, and system architecture.

This site documents practical tutorials, code examples, and technical explorations across backend engineering, AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot and Cline, and deep dives into technologies like Apache Kafka, Spring Boot, and VSCode extensions. Written by a developer sharing hands-on experience with modern development workflows.

## Key Topics

- Java backend development
- VSCode extensions and AI coding assistants
- GitHub Copilot and Cline
- Apache Kafka internals
- API integration and configuration
- Database migrations with Liquibase
- HTTP protocols and status codes
- XML and JSON parsing
- File system monitoring (FSEvents, Chokidar)
- Embeddings and AI APIs
- JUnit, Mockito, and testing frameworks
- Spring Boot and dependency injection
- Package analysis and codebase statistics
- Node.js build tools (Webpack, Vite)
- Interview preparation for backend engineers

## AI Coding Tools & VSCode

- [Getting Started with GitHub Copilot in VS Code](https://lzwjava.github.io/notes/2025-03-21-vscode-copilot-en): GitHub Copilot setup and configuration guide for Visual Studio Code
- [Using Cline in VSCode](https://lzwjava.github.io/notes/2025-03-21-vscode-cline-en): Setup guide for Cline AI coding assistant in VSCode with OpenRouter
- [Visual Studio Code (VSCode) Copilot plugin](https://lzwjava.github.io/notes/2025-03-21-vscode-copilot-key-en): Configure VSCode Copilot with custom API keys and Gemini integration
- [Mistral AI Embeddings](https://lzwjava.github.io/notes/2025-02-26-mistral-embedding-en): Python tutorial for Mistral AI embeddings API and semantic similarity
